tool_calls.name: ask_savings
tool_calls.arguments: {"question": "Please look at Jun's idea: put ₱4,000 extra a month on the credit card and send the rest of the unallocated surplus to the emergency fund. Show what that does for the emergency fund and the credit card."}

{"reply":"You have two clean choices that fit the current surplus.

One puts all the extra on the credit card, which clears it much sooner and cuts card interest more. That lines up with Mara’s wish to clear the card fast and with your avalanche preference.

The other uses Jun’s split: ₱4,000.00 extra on the card and the rest to the emergency fund. That gets the emergency fund to its target sooner, but the card stays around longer and costs more interest than the faster-paydown option.

Because you want different things here, I’m not picking one for you. If your priority is clearing the card fast, choose A.
